shared_elements: multiple figures side by side on a common baseline
human figures standing/seated in a row
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures arranged along a horizontal baseline, but that is a near-universal convention; A shows a multi-register scene of detailed figures with offering table, seated and standing persons, and columns of small sign-like marks, while B shows only two extremely reduced stick-like figures standing on a boat hull with upturned prows. The specific iconography — an offering scene with furniture and inscription versus a manned vessel rendered as solid silhouette — has essentially nothing distinctive in common.
